last_review.summary: The change meets AUTH-013-A’s acceptance criteria and complies with the architecture. The guard safely parses a single Bearer token, invokes the trusted verifier and resolver in sequence, attaches the unchanged Principal to the shared typed request property, and is exported as an opt-in provider. The decorator reads that same property. Changes are confined to src/identity/, and deterministic build and Prisma validation both passed.

notes: No tests are executed by loop V2.
Do not connect autonomous agents to the production Supabase database.
Core does not exist yet; Auth defines stable seams/contracts but does not implement Core.
Auth->Core internal request auth is Noop in V1; future signed JWT is a pluggable strategy.
